Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MGU Library Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the Mahatma Gandhi University Recruitment 2026 is High School Librarian.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the High School Librarian post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the High School Librarian position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the High School Librarian post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 17,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the High School Librarian post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree and B.Lisc/M.Lisc from any recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the High School Librarian post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Kerala, Pincode: 686560.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
